stem.text: Which compound would produce two different carboxylic acids when treated with hot, concentrated, acidified manganate(VII) ions?

A.alt: skeletal formula of a branched alkene with a methyl branch on each side of the C=C bond

B.alt: skeletal formula of a branched alkene with a C=C bond near one end and a methyl branch

D.alt: skeletal formula of a branched alkene with a C=C bond in the middle of the chain and a methyl branch at each end
